extensibility_gaps.suggested_filter: STILL TRUE as of 2.5.0. The widget render loop emits no apply_filters around the per-item markup or the final birthday list — the only filter reachable from the render path is bbirthdays_get_name_to_display (:1224), and its return is esc_html()'d so it cannot carry markup. Site owners cannot alter item output (avatar, age, zodiac, wish button) without forking. Consider a bbirthdays_widget_item filter around the item HTML and a bbirthdays_widget_birthdays filter on the assembled list. This gap affects the shortcode identically, since the shortcode calls the same widget().

phpcs_excludes.action: Per-line phpcs:ignore only (no file-level or ruleset excludes). Distribution: assets/inc/buddypress-birthdays-widget.php 14, core-init.php 4, includes/class-bp-birthdays-notifications.php 4, includes/admin/class-bp-birthdays-admin-panel.php 3, buddypress-birthdays.php 1. Predominantly intentional direct $wpdb xprofile reads (DirectQuery/NoCaching/PreparedSQL where dynamic SQL is assembled from static fragments with all values bound) plus EscapeOutput on the widget's trusted before/after wrapper markup. Review during any refactor.

notes: BB-1 (low, unchanged): assets/inc/buddypress-birthdays-widget.php:119,122 echo $args['before_widget'] and $args['before_title'] . esc_html( title ) . $args['after_title'] with EscapeOutput suppressed. The wrappers come from register_sidebar (trusted) and the title is escaped; the concatenation on :122 mixes trusted wrappers with an escaped title — acceptable, flagged for awareness.

BB-2 (low, MITIGATED since 2.4.1 — manifest previously overstated this): the cron birthday query (includes/class-bp-birthdays-notifications.php:519-527) is now scoped to the configured field_id, which IS indexed on {prefix}bp_xprofile_data, so it no longer full-scans the table. Residual cost: DATE_FORMAT(d.value,'%m-%d') remains non-sargable and runs per candidate row within that field_id partition (documented in-code at :502-513). The unindexed field-discovery queries against {prefix}bp_xprofile_fields (core-init.php:294-296, notifications.php:486-488, admin-panel.php:364-367) are small-table lookups with LIMIT 1 / ORDER BY name.

BB-3 (RESOLVED 2026-07-03 — manifest previously still described this as an open gap): every widget fetch path is now bounded. The 'all members' path (assets/inc/buddypress-birthdays-widget.php:482-521) and the friends/followers path via bound_members_by_upcoming_birthday() (:875-908) both trim candidates in SQL, ordered by upcoming-birthday proximity, to a pool sized by get_candidate_limit() (:823-859 — filters bb_birthdays_widget_candidate_multiplier default 4, bb_birthdays_widget_candidate_cap default 200). Per-user N+1 is eliminated by prime_birthday_values() batch priming (:723-786). Render is now O(cap), not O(members).

BB-4 (low, MITIGATED): send_bp_notifications (includes/class-bp-birthdays-notifications.php:706-780) still caps non-friends recipients, but the cap is now filterable via bb_birthdays_notification_recipient_limit (:728, default 500, 0/-1 = unbounded) and truncation is logged rather than silent.

BB-5 (info, NEW 2026-07-16): the pagination at assets/inc/buddypress-birthdays-widget.php:126-160 slices an already-fetched in-memory list rather than paging in SQL. This is correct given the upstream candidate cap (max 200 rows), but it means page N does not exist beyond min(total_fetched, birthdays_to_display) — deep pages are bounded by the cap, not by real member count. Intentional; documented so it is not re-filed as a pagination bug.

BB-6 (info, NEW 2026-07-16): user meta bb_birthday_hidden (the GDPR opt-out) is NOT removed by uninstall.php (which deletes only bb_birthday_wished_users, :32). A member's privacy choice therefore survives plugin delete + reinstall. Arguably correct (fail-closed on privacy), but it is an undocumented divergence from the 'uninstall removes all plugin data' claim in the uninstall.php docblock (:5-7). Needs an owner decision, not a silent fix.
BB-7 (info, NEW 2026-07-16): dist/ contains only buddypress-birthdays-2.4.1.zip while the shipped version is 2.5.0 — the 2.5.0 release artifact has not been built.
